River West · Restored 1902 Factory

Slow down. Soak in candlelight.

The Circuit

Seven waters, one slow loop

Move at your own pace through the ancient circuit. Warm, then cool, then float — and rest between each step. No rushing, no timetable shouted across the room.

  1. 01

    Caldarium — the hot bath

    Start warm. Let the heat loosen the day before anything else.

  2. 02

    Tepidarium — the warm bath

    Settle into a gentler warmth and slow your breathing down.

  3. 03

    Frigidarium — the cold bath

    A short, bracing plunge that sharpens everything after the heat.

  4. 04

    Flotarium — the salt pool

    Float weightless in salt water, in near-silence, under candlelight.

  5. 05

    Steam & sauna

    Steam, then the dry sauna — newly added at the Chicago baths.

  6. 06

    Cold plunge

    Finish the contrast: heat, then cold, then rest.

  7. 07

    Rest

    Warm towels, stillness, and time. The circuit is not complete without it.

Rituals & Massages

Stay longer. Add a ritual.

Massages and rituals turn a bath session into a full occasion — an anniversary, a birthday, a gift, or simply a day set aside for yourself. Packages run into the several-hundred-dollar range, and the full $250–$650 range is stated here so there are no surprises at the booking widget.

Gift idea: a ritual session makes a ready-made gift — ask about gift and ritual options when you request your session below, and we will confirm the exact package and price before anything is charged.

Ask About Gifts & Rituals

The Building

A 1902 factory, kept warm

AIRE Chicago sits in River West in a restored 1902 factory. Brick arches, high ceilings and candlelight do the decorating — the building itself is part of the experience, not a backdrop to it.

That history is why the rooms feel the way they do: solid, quiet, and a little out of time. You arrive off a Chicago street and step into something older and slower.

Good to Know

Before your first session

How does a session work?

Arrive, change, and follow the circuit at your own pace — warm baths, cold plunge, salt flotarium, steam and sauna — with rest between steps. Sessions are capacity-capped, so the rooms stay quiet.

Is it adults-only?

Yes. AIRE Chicago sessions are adults-only.

What do packages cost?

The published package range is $250–$650. The exact package and price for your chosen session and any ritual add-on are confirmed when you book.

Can I give a session as a gift?

Yes — mention “gift” in the booking form below and ask about gift and ritual options.

Where is it, and when is it open?

800 West Superior St., Chicago, IL 60642. Mon 8am–10pm; Tue & Wed 9am–10pm; Thu 9am–11pm; Fri–Sun 8am–11pm.
